definitions.explanation: Rare, naturally occurring metallic elements with high economic value, such as gold, silver, and platinum. Also used to refer to jewelry and accessories made from these metals.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}は{貴金属|ききんぞく}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Gold is one of the precious metals.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{貴金属|ききんぞく}{店|てん}がある。
examples.english: There is a jewelry store in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {貴金属|ききんぞく}の{価格|かかく}は{世界|せかい}{経済|けいざい}の{動向|どうこう}に{大|おお}きく{左右|さゆう}される。
examples.english: Precious metal prices are greatly influenced by global economic trends.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {貴|き} (precious, noble) + {金属|きんぞく} (metal). Refers both to the metals themselves (gold, silver, platinum, palladium) and to the jewelry industry. {貴金属|ききんぞく}{店|てん} is a common term for a jewelry store.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貴金属|ききんぞく}{店|てん} (jewelry store)
- {貴金属|ききんぞく}の{買取|かいとり} (purchasing of precious metals)
- {貴金属|ききんぞく}{相場|そうば} (precious metals market price)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宝石|ほうせき}: gemstone, jewel — precious stones rather than metals
- {金属|きんぞく}: metal — the general term for metals
